frameworkLeaves: C++ standard library contracts: std::memcmp, std::multimap::find/end with the explicitly bound comparator, type traits and ordinary scalar casts. No standard-library implementation audit.

UE generic container/pointer/optional/range/allocator/string-storage/lifetime/intern-pool allocation and logging/ensure/assert APIs remain explicit framework leaves. Their callers and key comparison/hash contracts are bound; arbitrary mutation, iteration-order or memory-safety proofs are not supplied.

Numeric parsing/formatting, localized FText true/false spellings and general Unicode/encoding behavior remain framework leaves outside the concrete ASCII bool/case examples. No equivalence to .NET Unicode OrdinalIgnoreCase.
Roslyn/.NET/OS/process and unrelated descriptor/parser grammar APIs remain outside this finite lookup/conversion proposal. No whole-engine or all-platform recursion.

RapidJSON generic parsing/serialization, value construction/mutation/copy/move, member/array iterator and allocator contracts remain explicit framework APIs beyond the selected exact member/type lookup functions. No arbitrary lexical-order, duplicate/case-colliding key, embedded-NUL preservation, precision or custom allocator proof.

Compact/sparse storage allocation, hash bucket/index memory layout, GetData/GetHashTableMemory/GetSetLayout, insertion/removal/rehash and allocator internals remain explicit framework APIs. Only exact key equality/hash, caller binding, lookup control and compact dispatch are supplemented.

Runtime compile choices UE_USE_COMPACT_SET_AS_DEFAULT, UE_JSONOBJECT_LEGACY_STRING_KEYS, RAPIDJSON_USE_MEMBERSMAP and TCHAR/platform choices remain source-conditioned and unobserved in installed binaries. Both selected comparison/lookup branches are supplied without asserting an actual runtime selection.
